violation_type.title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §744.603(a)(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: Two children were present at the operation and did not have enrollment agreements.    This was corrected during the inspection when the director brought the agreements for the children.

finding_variants.text: Two children were present at the operation and did not have enrollment agreements.    This was corrected during the inspection when the director brought the agreements for the children.
Children records were re-reviewed. Enrollment agreements was only available for 2 of the 6 children enrolled.
One of the ten children records was unavailable for review.    One of the ten children files didn't have physician/ hospital information.
Ten of 10 children's children's records reviewed did not have signed documentation showing the family receive the operational policies.
Three children in care were not enrolled at the operation,

A sampling of children records were evaluated. Two children's records lacked the complete address (city and state) of their designated contact. Eight children's records lacked authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment. Eight children lacked documentation that their parents received and reviewed a copy of the operations, operational policies.
